title: Grateful Dead Live at Robert F. Kennedy Stadium on 1973-06-09
lineage: SBD MR > cassette> DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the June 9 1973 show with crystal‑clear mix and stellar performances – especially Eyes, China Doll, Loose Lucy and a juicy Playin' jam.
ai_review.review: The SBD recording is remarkably clean, preserving the famed Wall‑of‑Sound ambience while delivering a crisp drum overhead and balanced instrument separation; only the opening track feels a bit flat. Musically the concert shines on the second half with standout renditions of Eyes of the World, China Doll, Loose Lucy and an inspired Playin' jam, even though the first set is described as routine and Jerry’s lyric slip on Half‑Step is noted. Overall the show is celebrated for its energy, improvisational depth and memorable vocal moments.

ai_rating.rationale: 32 reviews overwhelmingly positive (average ★4.38), with consistent praise for both the soundboard quality and musical performance; only a few minor criticisms do not affect the high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, well‑balanced mix with clear drum overhead; some listeners note early‑track flatness or a perception of speed, but overall the SBD captures the Wall‑of‑Sound depth and ambience superbly.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The second set is consistently highlighted as the high point, with smooth transitions (e.g., Truckin' → Playing via a Here Comes Sunshine intro) and an overall energetic, improvisational flow that outweighs a more routine first half.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for smooth vocal delivery and rich guitar tone; a brief lyric stumble on Half‑Step is mentioned but not detrimental.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for excellent bass work, especially on Eyes of the World; fans appreciate his presence throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Bob: Received a mixed note – criticized for a weaker Truckin' performance by one reviewer, while another points out an impromptu lyric change in Me and My Uncle.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum sound is highlighted as crisp with an effective overhead mic that adds life to the mix.
